questions.question: When Israel faced horses, chariots and a bigger army in battle, why were they told not to be afraid?

answers.text: The LORD their God is with them
Their swords are stronger than chariots
Their enemies will run away first

questions.question: Before Israel went into battle, who was to come forward and speak to the army?
When Israel approached a city to fight against it, what were they told to do first?
Israel was told to completely destroy the nations living in the land God was giving them. Why?

answers.text: So they can't teach Israel what they do for their gods
So Israel can take all of their silver and gold
So they can't attack Israel's cities from behind
